# Update for <customer / support agent> — <ticket id>

> **Audience:** non-engineers. No class names, no stack traces, no jargon.
> Read it aloud: if a sentence needs an engineer to explain it, rewrite it.

Hi <name>,

**What happened.** <One or two sentences in the customer's terms.
"The times on your sign-in history were shown an hour early.">

**Were you affected, and is your account safe?** <Answer the question they
are actually worried about, first and directly.>

**What we've done.** <The fix, in outcome terms. "Times now show correctly
in your own time zone.">

**Anything you need to do.** <Usually "Nothing." If there is something,
make it a numbered list of steps.>

**If you see it again.** <What to send us: a screenshot, the time it
happened and your time zone.>

Thanks for reporting it. Your report included <the detail that helped>,
which is what let us find it quickly.

<signature>
